manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
